title: Seven-minute value warm-up
alt_text: Three warm-up stages show fixing the fruit and lamp, grouping the fruit and cast shadow into three values, and squinting to check the thumbnail.
caption: The diagram is a short sequence; match the actual fruit rather than copying its shapes.

review_notes: Portrait layout uses large labels and shows the cast shadow extending to the right of the fruit.
